title: 迢迢牵牛星
titleEn: Far, Far Away, the Herd-boy Star
author: 佚名（《古诗十九首》）
intro: Two stars on either side of the Milky Way — the Herd-boy and the Weaver Girl — are lovers who can see each other but never speak. This Han dynasty poem is one of the earliest tellings of the story behind Qixi, China’s Valentine’s Day.
analysis: 这首诗写的是天上的两颗星：牵牛星和织女星，它们隔着银河遥遥相对。诗人把它们写成一对分离的恋人。前六句写织女：她伸出白白细细的手，札札地织着布，可是一整天也织不成花纹，眼泪像雨一样落下——因为心里想念牛郎，根本没有心思织布。后四句是诗人的感叹：银河又清又浅，两人到底隔得有多远呢？只隔着一条清浅的河水，却只能默默相望，说不出一句话。全诗十句里有六句用了叠字（迢迢、皎皎、纤纤、札札、盈盈、脉脉），读起来音节柔和，感情绵长。后来这个故事发展成“牛郎织女”的传说：每年农历七月初七，喜鹊在银河上搭桥让他们相会，这一天就是七夕节。
analysisEn: The poem is about two stars, the Herd-boy (Altair) and the Weaver Girl (Vega), which shine on opposite sides of the Milky Way. The poet imagines them as lovers kept apart. The first six lines are about the Weaver Girl. She lifts her slender white hands and works her loom — click, clack — yet after a whole day she still hasn’t finished a single pattern, and her tears fall like rain. Her heart is with the Herd-boy, not with her weaving. The last four lines are the poet’s own sigh: the River of Stars is clear and shallow, so how far apart can they really be? Only one brimming stream lies between them, yet all they can do is gaze at each other in silence. Six of the ten lines contain doubled characters (迢迢, 皎皎, 纤纤, 札札, 盈盈, 脉脉), which give the poem a soft, lingering music. The story later grew into the legend of the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl: once a year, on the seventh night of the seventh lunar month, magpies form a bridge across the Milky Way so the two can meet. That night is the Qixi Festival, often called Chinese Valentine’s Day.
background: The “Nineteen Old Poems” (古诗十九首) are anonymous five-character poems written by scholars of the late Eastern Han (around the 2nd century AD) and gathered in the 6th-century anthology Selections of Refined Literature (文选). Their plain, moving style made them a model for Chinese five-character poetry.
pronunciation: 盈盈一水间的“间”读 jiàn（隔开，通行教材注 jiàn）；脉脉 mò mò（含情相望，不读 mài）；迢迢 tiáo tiáo；纤纤 xiān xiān；擢 zhuó；札札 zhá zhá；杼 zhù；泣涕的“涕”读 tì（眼泪）；相去的“相”读 xiāng。
version: 采用通行的《文选》本《古诗十九首》（第十首），全诗十句，网站按两句一行排版，共五行。

lines.zh: 迢迢牵牛星，皎皎河汉女。
lines.rhythm: 迢迢/牵牛星，皎皎/河汉女
lines.py: tiáo tiáo qiān niú xīng, jiǎo jiǎo hé hàn nǚ
lines.lit: Far, far away is the Herd-boy Star; bright, bright is the girl of the Milky Way.
lines.en: Far off shines the Herd-boy Star; bright is the Weaver Girl across the Milky Way.

lines.zh: 纤纤擢素手，札札弄机杼。
lines.rhythm: 纤纤/擢素手，札札/弄机杼
lines.py: xiān xiān zhuó sù shǒu, zhá zhá nòng jī zhù
lines.lit: Slender, slender, she raises her white hands; click-clack, she works the loom and shuttle.
lines.en: She lifts her slender white hands — click, clack goes the shuttle through her loom.
lines.tts: 纤纤浊素手，闸闸弄机住。

lines.zh: 终日不成章，泣涕零如雨。
lines.rhythm: 终日/不成章，泣涕/零如雨
lines.py: zhōng rì bù chéng zhāng, qì tì líng rú yǔ
lines.lit: All day she cannot finish a pattern; her weeping tears fall like rain.
lines.en: All day she weaves, yet no pattern grows — her tears fall like rain.

lines.zh: 河汉清且浅，相去复几许？
lines.rhythm: 河汉/清且浅，相去/复几许
lines.py: hé hàn qīng qiě qiǎn, xiāng qù fù jǐ xǔ
lines.lit: The Milky Way is clear and shallow; how far apart are they, after all?
lines.en: The River of Stars is clear and shallow — how far apart can they really be?

lines.zh: 盈盈一水间，脉脉不得语。
lines.rhythm: 盈盈/一水间，脉脉/不得语
lines.py: yíng yíng yī shuǐ jiàn, mò mò bù dé yǔ
lines.lit: Separated by one brimming stretch of water, they gaze silently and cannot speak.
lines.en: Just one brimming stream between them — they gaze in silence, and cannot say a word.
lines.tts: 盈盈一水见，默默不得语。

words.en: the girl by the Milky Way — the Weaver Girl Star (Vega)

words.note: 现代汉语“纤细”“纤纤玉手”。
古义“伸出、抬起”；今天“擢升”指提拔。
杼：织布的梭子。今天少用。
古义指花纹；今天“章”指文章、章节。
古义“落下”，“零落”里还保留；今天多指数字 0。
书面语，今天说“多少”“多远”。
现代汉语“笑意盈盈”“热泪盈眶”。
现代汉语“含情脉脉”，读 mò。

imagery.name: 牵牛织女
imagery.zh: 两颗星隔河相望，象征一对相爱却不能相聚的恋人。
imagery.en: Two stars facing each other across the river: lovers who cannot be together.

imagery.name: 银河
imagery.zh: 清浅的银河看起来很近，却永远隔开了他们，是爱情中无法跨越的阻隔。
imagery.en: The clear, shallow Milky Way looks easy to cross, yet it keeps them apart forever — a barrier love cannot pass.
